messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Annex I, 3.4.4

3.4.4. Falling objects Where, in the case of self-propelled machinery with a ride-on driver, operator(s) or other person(s), there is a risk due to falling objects or material, the machinery must be designed and constructed in such a way as to take account of this risk and fitted, if its size allows, with an appropriate protective structure. This structure must be such that, in the event of falling objects or material, it guarantees the ride-on person(s) an adequate deflection-limiting volume. In order to verify that the structure complies with the requirement laid down in the second paragraph, the manufacturer or his authorised representative must, for each type of structure concerned, perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed.

response.text:
self-propelled machinery with ride-on person | must take account of falling-object risk in design and construction | machinery | where there is a risk due to falling objects or material | "the machinery must be designed and constructed in such a way as to take account of this risk"
self-propelled machinery | is fitted with a protective structure | appropriate protective structure | if its size allows | "fitted, if its size allows, with an appropriate protective structure"
protective structure | guarantees adequate deflection-limiting volume | ride-on person(s) | in the event of falling objects or material | "it guarantees the ride-on person(s) an adequate deflection-limiting volume"
manufacturer or authorised representative | performs or has performed tests on protective structure | each type of structure concerned | to verify compliance with the structure requirement | "must, for each type of structure concerned, perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed"
